entries.en: The analyst noted that the sample had been acidized before measurement.
entries.zh: 分析人员注明，该样品在测量前已用酸处理。

entries.en: Her analysis distinguished the adenylylated protein from its unmodified form.
entries.zh: 她的分析把腺苷酸化的蛋白质与其未修饰形式区分开来。

entries.en: The case report explained why the surgeon chose to adrenalectomize the patient.
entries.zh: 病例报告解释了外科医生为何选择为该患者实施肾上腺切除术。
